purpose: Teach: 志願/裏切り/改悪/増幅/治癒/固執/埋葬/ファシズム

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時志願兵の心理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — I noticed you covered wartime volunteer psychology in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested tone. Gentle opening, inviting acknowledgment. Steady pace, unhurried. The air of a teacher who's read carefully and wants to show it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政治家の裏切りの事例史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at historical examples of political betrayal.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. No performance, just clarity. Brief pause after the confirmation, then the substance. Measured cadence, respectful of the exchange.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 改悪と批判された制度改革を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also covered institutional reform that was criticized as making things worse, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly exploratory tone. Phrasing as a gentle question rather than assertion. Unhurried, reflective rhythm. Inviting her to expand or confirm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、メディアによる情報増幅を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how media amplification shaped the information flow.
lines.style: Clear and composed. Confident without being rigid. Steady delivery, grounded. The ease of someone answering a fair question.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統医療における自然治癒を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you wrote about natural healing in traditional medicine systems?
lines.style: Engaged but not prescriptive. Open curiosity, genuinely following her thinking. Soft upturn at the question. Warm rhythm, collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政策に固執して失敗した例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed a case where policy rigidity led to failure.
lines.style: Direct and analytical. Spoken with the calm of someone presenting their own findings. No hesitation, clear-eyed. Straightforward pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦死者の埋葬慣習史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the history of burial customs for the war dead, I see.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Gentle acknowledgment rather than interrogation. Slight pause for weight. The tone of connecting pieces together thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ファシズム台頭の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched how fascism rose to power historically.
lines.style: Firm closing answer. Direct, unflinching. Brief but complete. The finality of someone concluding their thought clearly, respectfully ending the exchange.
